title: Add Funded By Zukunft Bau Footer Button
description: Add a "Funded by Zukunft Bau" button with the Zukunft Bau logo to the shared app shell footer (framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx Footer items), positioned between the middle (centered) region and the right corner. It must link to https://www.zukunftbau.de/projekte/forschungsfoerderung/1008187-2506. Add a small inline SVG ZukunftBauLogo component to ui/js/react/index.tsx near the existing SemioLogo, following the same pattern (self-contained functional component accepting className/style). Wire it into the Footer's items array as a right-aligned (ms-auto) normal item rendering an anchor tag with the logo and label, opening in a new tab.
